data.fund_name: SBI Income Plus Arbitrage Active FOF
data.fund_type: An open-ended fund of fund (FOF) scheme investing in units of actively managed debt-oriented schemes and actively managed arbitrage mutual fund schemes.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme shall be to generate regular income and capital appreciation by investing in a mix of units of actively managed debt-oriented schemes and actively managed Arbitrage mutual fund schemes. However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.benchmark: 65% Nifty Composite Debt Index + 35% Nifty 50 Arbitrage Index
